_provenance: Library-defined GENERIC readiness criteria written for this repository, inspired by common systems-engineering review practice. They are NOT the entrance/success criteria of NASA NPR 7123.1 or any other standard (primary sources were inaccessible in-session). Replace or extend with your programme's approved criteria via --criteria.

criteria.text: Problem/mission need and stakeholders documented
At least one feasible concept and alternatives considered
Top risks and key assumptions identified with owners
Measures of effectiveness defined
ConOps and stakeholder needs baselined or approved for use
System requirements lint clean (no errors) and traced to needs
Every requirement has a verification method and acceptance criterion
TBD/TBR list with owners and closure dates
Risk register reviewed; high risks have handling plans
Technical plan (process tailoring, reviews, authorities) agreed
Functional decomposition complete and allocated to elements
Architecture selected with documented trade/decision analysis
Subsystem requirements flowed down and traced
Key interfaces identified in the ICD
Preliminary design meets all approved requirements by analysis or justified estimate
Interfaces defined with owners on both sides (ICD agreed)
Verification matrix covers every approved requirement
TPMs/budgets show positive margin against policy
Risk register current; residual high risks accepted by named authority
Hazard analysis performed and reviewed by a qualified person
Long-lead procurement and technology maturation plans exist
Detailed design complete and baselined for build
ICDs baselined; no unresolved interface conflicts
Test procedures drafted for all verification activities
Margins positive; no TPM in breach
Hazard controls designed and traced to verification
Integration plan defined with sequence and checks
Test article configuration identified and matches the baseline
Approved test procedure with pass/fail criteria
Test hazards analysed; safety controls (e-stop, guards, PPE) verified
Instrumentation calibrated and data capture verified
Roles, test director and abort criteria defined
Prior anomalies/NCRs dispositioned
All verification activities complete; failures dispositioned
As-built configuration audited against the baseline
Validation against stakeholder needs performed or justified
Known limitations, waivers and open issues documented
Transition package (docs, training, support) ready
Operations procedures and contingency procedures approved
Operators trained and certified as required
Monitoring, incident response and rollback in place
Residual risks accepted by the operating authority
